definitions.short: Salcah , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H5548. Salkah סַלְכָה proper name, of a location city on east border of Bashan , Deut 3:10 ; Josh 12:5 ; 13:11 (all D), 1Chr 5:11 ; = Nabataean עלתד (Lzb 358 Cook 101 ), modern ‚al—ad, ‚ar—ad , on southern spur of Jebel Hauran , approximately 63 miles due east of Jordan; compare Buhl Geogr. 252 Dr Deut 3:10 ; ᵐ5 Σελχα , Ελχα , etc. ( Σ lost often after ἔως ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root. meaning to walk; walking ;

occurrences.englishText: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
